subject_kind.description: Whether the profile belongs to an individual or an organisation.

subject_ref.description: Name or identifier of the subject (e.g., 'Acme Corp', 'Alice Smith').

platform.description: Platform or network (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, GitHub, Mastodon, etc.).

handle.description: Username or screen name on the platform (e.g., '@alice', 'alice-smith-42b').

url.description: Direct URL to the profile page.

source_name.description: Tool or agent that produced this record (e.g., 'osint-analyst', 'linkedin-scraper').

notes.description: Analyst commentary, caveats, or context that doesn't fit structured fields.

agent_name.description: Agent that retrieved or inferred this data.

artifact_ref.description: File or URL reference to the raw artifact (e.g., 'file:artifacts/linkedin-profile.html:1').

captured_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the data was captured.

command_run_id.description: Command-run audit row that produced this intel.

code_snapshot.description: Immutable source snapshot behind code-derived intel.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the source that supports this record.
